description: Hosting the 'Disrupt Asia - 2026' Tech Conference and Innovation Festival
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Digital Economy and GovTech Sri Lanka (Pvt) Ltd. have planned to host a National Tech Conference and Innovation Festival titled 'Disrupt Asia 2026'. The said Conference and Festival are expected to be conducted as a two-day event featuring a venture competition, dynamic plenaries, an exhibition, networking reception and other side events. A wide range of key stakeholders including Ministries and Government entities, private sector, industry stakeholders, academia, development partners, and international organizations are expected to participate in the same. The UNDP Sri Lanka has expressed its interest and readiness to serve as a Strategic Partner to the Ministry of Digital Economy for the 'Disrupt Asia 2026' Conference and Festival. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, to hold the 'Disrupt Asia 2026' National Tech Conference and Innovation Festival in collaboration with the UNDP Sri Lanka as a Strategic Partner, was approved by the Cabinet.
